# IBM Db2 TechX Summit 2026 — Project Submission

> **PR Title Format (required):** `[Submission] db2-sentinel-ai: Db2 Sentinel AI - Autonomous Financial Crime Surveillance Suite`
>
> **Folder Format (required):** `submissions/db2-sentinel-ai/`
>
> **Mandatory Next Step:** After opening this PR, submit the PR URL through the official Google Form: **https://forms.gle/n8GQL4tg7Yzftwu39**.

---

## 1. Project Overview

- **Project Title:** Db2 Sentinel AI: Autonomous Financial Crime Surveillance, Multi-Agent AML & Regulatory SAR Intelligence Platform
- **Project Slug (must match folder name):** `submissions/db2-sentinel-ai/`
- **Short Description (1–3 sentences):** An enterprise-grade, multi-agent financial intelligence and anti-money laundering (AML) platform powered by IBM Db2 12.1+ native vector search, transactional state checkpointers, recursive CTE circular routing analytics, and automated FinCEN/RBI Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) generation.
- **Problem Solved & Target Audience:** 
  - **Problem Solved:** Solves the critical $3.1 Trillion global money laundering crisis, 95% false-positive rate in banking surveillance, and 4–6 hour manual investigation bottleneck per alert by transforming IBM Db2 into an autonomous surveillance and forensic analysis hub.
  - **Target Audience:** Enterprise tier-1 bank compliance teams, Money Laundering Reporting Officers (MLROs), Financial Intelligence Units (FIUs), and database architects looking to unify high-throughput transaction processing with vector AI without risking data exfiltration.

## 3. IBM Db2 Integration Summary

- **IBM Db2 Edition / Environment:** IBM Db2 12.1.2+ (Docker Community Edition & Enterprise) with Dual-Mode Zero-Setup Local Emulation fallback.
- **How IBM Db2 is Used in the Solution:** 
  - **Native In-Database Vector Search:** Leverages Db2 12.1+ `VECTOR(384, FLOAT32)` column type and `VECTOR_DISTANCE(..., 'COSINE')` to semantically match unstructured transaction memos and shell invoices against the FATF international crime typologies catalog.
  - **Recursive CTE Graph Traversal:** Executes `WITH RECURSIVE` SQL Common Table Expressions directly inside Db2 to identify multi-hop circular fund routing (A → B → C → A) and money mule aggregation rings.
  - **Analytical Window Functions:** Employs Db2 window functions (`AVG(...) OVER (PARTITION BY RECEIVER_ID ORDER BY TX_TIMESTAMP ...)`) to catch sub-threshold structuring/smurfing patterns ($9,000–$9,999).
  - **ACID Agent State Checkpoint Persistence:** Persists intermediate LangGraph multi-agent execution states directly into `AGENT_CHECKPOINTS` in Db2 for fault-tolerance, pause-and-resume workflows, and complete replayability.
  - **Tamper-Evident Temporal Audit Ledger:** Logs every agent reasoning step, SQL query, and compliance officer decision into `AUDIT_TRAIL` sealed with SHA-256 cryptographic signatures.
- **Db2 Connector / Driver / Framework Integration Used:** `ibm_db` (native C-driver bindings), `ibm_db_sa` (SQLAlchemy dialect), and custom Db2 state checkpointer.
- **Schema & Data Stored / Processed:** 8 specialized relational and vector tables (`ACCOUNTS`, `TRANSACTIONS`, `SANCTIONS_WATCHLIST`, `AML_TYPOLOGIES`, `INVESTIGATION_ALERTS`, `AGENT_CHECKPOINTS`, `AUDIT_TRAIL`, `SAR_FILINGS`).
- **Steps to Verify Db2 Integration:**
  ```bash
  cd submissions/db2-sentinel-ai
  pytest tests/ -v
  python src/main.py
  ```

---

## 4. Technology Stack & AI / LLM Usage

- **Programming Languages:** Python 3.10+
- **Frameworks & Libraries:** LangGraph, LangChain, SQLAlchemy, Streamlit, NetworkX, Scikit-Learn, ReportLab, Rich
- **AI / LLM Framework (if applicable):** LangGraph (Cyclical Multi-Agent StateGraph)
- **Model Provider & Model Name (if applicable):** `ibm-granite/granite-embedding-311m-multilingual-r2` (local/Sentence-Transformers) and Ollama `granite3.3:8b` / OpenAI / Google Gemini (with built-in deterministic heuristic fallback).
- **Where AI/LLM is Applied in the Workflow:**
  - `ScreeningAgent`: Intercepts transactions, evaluates statutory thresholds, and screens against Db2 sanctions watchlists.
  - `ForensicInvestigatorAgent`: Queries historical Db2 ledgers and executes in-database native vector similarity search against international money laundering typologies.
  - `GraphRiskAgent`: Analyzes transaction network graphs and circular fund flow loops using Db2 recursive SQL.
  - `SARDrafterAgent`: Auto-generates structured, legally compliant 5-part FinCEN/RBI Suspicious Activity Reports citing exact Db2 transaction IDs.
  - `SupervisorAgent`: Human-in-the-loop gatekeeper that executes account freezes in Db2 and cryptographically signs audit trails.

## 6. Submission Verification Checklist

Please verify and check every item before requesting review:

- [x] **Folder Structure:** My submission is placed in a single new directory under `submissions/db2-sentinel-ai/` copied from `submissions/_template/`.
- [x] **Naming Conventions:** The `<project-slug>` uses lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only, matching the branch name and PR title.
- [x] **Complete Documentation:** Both `submissions/db2-sentinel-ai/README.md` and `submissions/db2-sentinel-ai/architecture.md` are completely filled out without unfilled placeholder markers.
- [x] **Metadata File:** `submissions/db2-sentinel-ai/submission.json` is completed and valid JSON.
- [x] **No Secrets or Credentials:** No API keys, passwords, private tokens, or connection strings with real credentials are committed. `.env.example` contains placeholders only.
- [x] **Tested Setup Instructions:** Setup and run instructions were tested from a fresh environment and can be reproduced by reviewers.
- [x] **License Declared:** Open-source license or distribution terms are specified (Apache 2.0).
- [x] **Code of Conduct:** All team members agree to adhere to the repository [Code of Conduct](../../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [x] **Scope Isolation:** This PR only adds/modifies files inside `submissions/db2-sentinel-ai/` and does not touch root files or other submissions.
- [x] **Google Form Submission:** I understand that opening this PR is step 1, and I will submit this PR URL into the official Google Form (https://forms.gle/n8GQL4tg7Yzftwu39).

## 7. Additional Notes for Reviewers & Judges

- **Dual-Mode Engine for 100% Reproducibility:** To ensure reviewing judges can evaluate the application immediately without waiting 15 minutes to pull a 4GB Docker container, the architecture includes an automatic high-fidelity local engine with full vector cosine distance and window function support.
- **Preloaded Landmark Test Cases:**
  1. *Case 1 (Structuring):* Sub-threshold wires split below \$10,000 targeting `Pan-Asia Invoicing FZE`.
  2. *Case 2 (Circular Layering):* Multi-hop circular laundering loop across British Virgin Islands, Cyprus, and Seychelles shell entities.
  3. *Case 3 (Sanctions Evasion):* Wire referencing maritime bunkering for OFAC-sanctioned `Titan Petrochemical Trading LLC`.
  4. *Case 4 (Normal Baseline):* Routine enterprise software payment.
- **Round 1 Proposal Included:** A publication-grade Round 1 Proposal document and compiled PDF are located in `submissions/db2-sentinel-ai/docs/Round_1_Proposal_Db2_Sentinel_AI.pdf`.
